findings.location: Final paragraph, quotation and reference to Joel 2:25a
findings.source_quote: God truly has fulfilled His promise to … restore to [us] the years that the locust hath eaten! (Joel 2:25a)
findings.suggested_fix: This is a Scripture quotation, but scripture_evidence contains no quote evidence for it and the selection audit has no corresponding selection. Add the exact approved target-language verse evidence for the printed quotation and provide its required selection; do not invent or supply Scripture wording without that evidence.
findings.translation_quote: Gud har verkligen uppfyllt sitt löfte att … ge [oss] tillbaka de år som gräshopporna har ätit upp! (Joel 2:25a)

findings.location: Paragraph beginning “My, Ann’s response to Mark’s repentance…”
findings.source_quote: My, Ann’s response to Mark’s repentance was full and free forgiveness.
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the attribution to match the source as printed: revise “Mitt svar, Anns svar” so the sentence attributes the full and free forgiveness to Ann, without adding Mark as a co-respondent.
findings.translation_quote: Mitt svar, Anns svar, på Marks omvändelse var fullständig och villkorslös förlåtelse.

findings.location: Paragraph beginning “First, it must be said…”
findings.source_quote: It took many deep, heartfelt tears of repentance and close accountability to each other.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a natural Swedish expression for mutual accountability, such as “och att de regelbundet ställde varandra till svars”, rather than wording that can suggest keeping one another closely responsible.
findings.translation_quote: Det krävdes många djupa, innerliga tårar av ånger och att de höll varandra nära ansvariga.
